invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of IOUtils.runMerge(), which is expected to be non-null.
instantTime is typically required to be a non-empty String representing an operation timestamp.
fileId must be specified to identify the file being updated.
The map of records to update (keyToNewRecords) is essential for the update operation and cannot be null.
The old data file being updated must be specified and non-null for a valid update operation.
